sections.title: Geopolitical Risk & Policy Uncertainty
sections.note: Cards: latest reading; 30-day average (daily series) or 3-month average (monthly) vs the trailing 1-year average; and the percentile of that average against its full history. The indexes count newspaper articles on each theme (higher = more risk/uncertainty). Daily indexes are noisy, so the charts use moving averages.

sections.title: Chokepoint Traffic (IMF PortWatch)
sections.note: Daily vessel transit calls estimated by IMF PortWatch from AIS satellite data, shown as 7-day averages. Cards compare the latest 7-day average with the same dates a year earlier (364 days, same weekdays) and with the 2019-2022 average for the same calendar date (the pre-2023, pre-Red Sea-attack baseline). PortWatch publishes with about a one-week lag; the as-of date is on each card.
